title: PAY-2114: Canary Alarms During Deploy — Incident Review
body: PAY-2114 summary: a payments-service deploy on 2026-06-28 tripped canary alarms 6 minutes into the 5% rollout — authorization failure rate rose from 0.2% to 4.1%. Auto-rollback triggered and fully reverted within 90 seconds; no customer-facing outage, but roughly 340 authorization attempts failed during the canary window and were not automatically retried. Root cause: a new connection-pool setting for the Stripe client was too aggressive for the canary pod's lower traffic share, causing premature connection eviction. Fix: the connection-pool floor now scales with traffic percentage rather than using a fixed value. Marcus Webb was on call and handled the response; Priya Natarajan led the follow-up fix. Action item: add a synthetic-traffic floor to canary pods so connection pools warm up correctly regardless of real traffic share — tracked as a follow-up ticket.
